Contributors: Des Barres, Joseph F. W. (Joseph Frederick Wallet), 1729-1824

L.C. Copy no. 19, with 112 items. Vols. 1 and 2 dated 1779; v. 3, without general t.p., has sectional t.p. to the New England section dated 1780. Charts and views dated 1775 to 1780. Two engr. sheets, headed "Contents of the charts" and "Views of the coast of Nova Scotia," respectively, follow the general title by v. 1 and are repeated after the general title in v. 2. Plates numbered 5 to 68 are listed on these. Vol. 3 has the "Preface" printed on a narrow folio sheet. It is followed by a ms. table of contents on paper with watermark "Whatman 1811," listing 33 charts and views. Cf. H. N. Stevens.
